global.question: What is the best sword in Broken Blade?
global.answer: The best swords in Broken Blade are Dragon Slayer and Broken Blade for late-game. Dragon Slayer is the strongest Buster, while Broken Blade is the top Sword. Excalibur is also S-tier after the Eclipse update.

global.question: What is the best race in Broken Blade?
global.answer: Aesir is the best overall race with +75% Damage, +10% Crit Chance, and +100% Crit Damage. For specific builds, Vanir is best for Katana, Nether is best for Buster, and Elf is best for Sword.

global.question: What is the best blessing in Broken Blade?
global.answer: Odin is the strongest blessing overall (+200% Damage, +75% Crit Damage). For Boss Rush, Jormungandr is excellent. For Buster builds, Thor and Surtr are top picks.

global.question: What is the best element in Broken Blade?
global.answer: Thunder is the best element for crit builds (+50% Crit Damage). Fire is the most reliable damage element (+50% Damage). Wind is great for fast weapons like Katana.

global.question: How do you redeem Broken Blade codes?
global.answer: Open Broken Blade in Roblox, tap the Twitter/codes button (usually in settings or menu), enter the code exactly as shown, and press Redeem. Codes are case-sensitive.

global.question: Does Broken Blade have a Trello?
global.answer: There is no official Trello board confirmed for Broken Blade. The best place for updates is the official Discord server.

global.question: What is the official Broken Blade Discord?
global.answer: The official Discord can be found through the Roblox game page or social links on the game's description.

global.question: How do you unlock blessings?
global.answer: Blessings unlock at level 1000. You can reroll blessings by defeating the Gelaros boss and trading.

global.question: How do you reroll races?
global.answer: Races unlock at level 500. You can reroll by defeating the Nivaron boss and through trading.

global.question: How do you beat Boss Rush?
global.answer: Bring a high-damage build with sustain. Best setup: Dragon Slayer or Buster with Aesir/Nether race, Thunder/Fire element, and Odin/Jormungandr blessing. Prioritize damage reduction while learning, then switch to full DPS.

codes.question: Why are my Broken Blade codes not working?
codes.answer: Codes may be expired, already redeemed on your account, or entered incorrectly (codes are case-sensitive). Check that you are typing the code exactly as shown, including capital letters.

codes.question: Where do new Broken Blade codes come from?
codes.answer: New codes are usually released on the official Discord, in Roblox game updates, or during milestone celebrations (likes milestones, update launches).

best-swords.question: What is the best sword for beginners?
best-swords.answer: Sword is the most straightforward starting weapon. Upgrade to Katana if you prefer faster attacks, or Buster if you want higher damage per hit.

best-swords.question: How do you upgrade weapons in Broken Blade?
best-swords.answer: Use the Forge system to upgrade weapons. Higher-tier weapons require materials from bosses and the progression route.

races-tier-list.question: Should I reroll my race?
races-tier-list.answer: Reroll if you have a Common or Uncommon race (Human, Dwarves). Keep any Epic or higher race until you have a clear build direction. Aesir is worth keeping no matter what.

blessings-tier-list.question: When should I start rerolling blessings?
blessings-tier-list.answer: Wait until level 1000 when blessings unlock. Do not waste rerolls before you know your weapon type and build direction.

elements-tier-list.question: Can I change my element?
elements-tier-list.answer: Yes, you can reroll elements by defeating the Velik boss and through trading.

boss-rush.question: What level should I be for Boss Rush?
boss-rush.answer: Aim for at least level 1000 with a fully upgraded weapon and a good blessing before attempting Boss Rush consistently.

dragon-slayer-reforge.question: Is Dragon Slayer Reforge worth it?
dragon-slayer-reforge.answer: Yes. Dragon Slayer is one of the strongest weapons in Broken Blade and the Reforge path upgrades it significantly. It is a top priority for Buster build players.

forge.question: What should I forge first?
forge.answer: Prioritize your main weapon upgrade path. If you are on the Buster route, focus on Buster and Dragon Slayer materials.

progression.question: What should I do first in Broken Blade?
progression.answer: Focus on leveling to 500 to unlock race and element rerolls, then specialize your build. Follow the progression: Level 500 → Reroll → Level 1000 → Blessing → Boss Rush → Reforge.

level-15000.question: How long does it take to reach level 15000?
level-15000.answer: It depends on your build and playtime. With an optimized Katana or Buster build and active farming, most players reach max level in a few weeks of consistent play.
